summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.67/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.67 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 21, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 13¢ lower than a week ago, 72¢ lower than a month ago, and 68¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.50) and the highest in Rhinelander ($3.94).
